column1: # Tennessee Administrative Office of the Courts, "Trial Court Judges": the
# Read ONCE on 2026-11-25 in the operator's own Chrome (Adam's yes of that day:
# a site that refuses this project's reader may be read once by hand, and a
# browser check that clears by itself may be passed). No check page appeared;
# robots.txt (User-agent: *) disallows only Drupal's admin, search and login
# paths, none of them read here. This project's own reader still meets the
# managed challenge measured 2026-10-09, so no weekly job reads this site.
# The directory's own list, all 28 pages of 25 (/judges1, every judge type,
# 700 rows), kept to its four trial-court types: Chancellor 35, Circuit Court
# Judge 98, Criminal Court Judge 39, Probate Court Judge 2 = 174 rows, copied
# exactly as the table prints them. Columns, tab-separated: name, the judge's
# page on www.tncourts.gov, office, counties, district. The directory leaves
# the district blank for the 32nd (its district filter stops at 31) and one
# shell page has no county or district.
# THE DIRECTORY IS NOT CURRENT. Read against the courts' own appointment and
# vacancy notices (tncourts-notices-2026-11-25.tsv), it still lists seven
# people who hold no district seat: four retired judges, the prior holders of
# the two seats the courts declared vacant, and a senior judge.
# tn/scripts/build_tn_trial_judges.py takes them out, each citing its notice,
# and refuses to run if any no longer matches a row here. It adds nobody: the
# 2025 appointees missing from it are missing from Nashville's own list too
